card.fires_on: The ending or start of the name Martínez/Martinez (the 'nez' after 'Martí', or 'Martinez' after a first name), and the start 'Mart' in names like Martini, Martina, Martingale.

modes.label: Martínez surname
modes.description: The 'nez' or 'Martinez' completing the surname Martínez after a first name or 'Martí'.

modes.label: Mart- name start
modes.description: The opening 'Mart' of a name or word such as Martini, Martina, Martingale, before the rest follows.

card.plain: It lights up on the surname Martínez and on names that begin with Mart-, such as Martina or Martini.
